svg.title: DeckTalk
svg.desc: A playhead moves along the narration "A bowl. A ball. One. Two, three.", one tick per word. A bowl appears on the slide on "bowl", and a ball appears on its rim on "ball". On each count word, the ball steps down the bowl and a box fills with that word's start time: 4.49 s, 5.26 s, and 5.77 s.

g.text: Every word has a start time, and each reveal waits for its word.
